description: This is a SQL schema file defining database schemas, tables, functions, triggers, indexes, and row-level security policies for a user authentication system, including user profiles and verification codes.

methods.name: app.set_profile_email
methods.description: Trigger function to set profile email from auth.users on insert or update.

methods.name: app.purge_expired_codes
methods.description: Function to delete expired or consumed verification codes older than 1 hour.

methods.name: app.mark_email_verified
methods.description: Function to mark a user's email as verified in the profiles table.

calls: auth.users (reference in foreign keys and select statements)
